post.description:
Search affiliate product listings by keyword, identifier, price, brand, merchant or network.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0025 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

keyword.description: Plain-text search such as `JBL speaker`; sent as the string form of `search`.

search.description:
Filter objects `{ field, value, operator }`, ANDed together. Fields include any, name, brand, category, barcode, sku, asin, merchant.id, network.id, final_price, currency, availability, on_sale, merchant.countries. Operators: =, !=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, >, <, >=, <=, NOT NULL. `||` in value ORs values.

Provider reference: maximum 30.

query.description: Rule builder `{ rules_operator: any|all, rules: [{ conditions_operator, conditions: [{ field, operator, value }] }] }`. Exclusive with keyword and search.

per_page.description:
Products per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10 here.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

page.description:
Page number, starting at 1.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

after.description: Deep-pagination cursor from the previous response's meta.after, for results past 10,000 on plans that allow it.

exact_total.description: Count meta.total past 10,000 precisely, at some extra latency.

fields.description:
Product fields to return, for example `id`, `name`, `final_price`, `urls`.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

sort_order.description:
Sort direction.

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"].

duplicate_fields_to_exclude.description: Deduplicate by name, image_url, direct_url, barcode or merchant.id. Comma syntax applies each independently and accepts `[N]` caps (`name,merchant.id[10]`); `a||b` drops a row when either has appeared.

facets.description:
Aggregations to include: network, merchant, final_price, or dotted sub-fields such as network.name.

200.description:
Products under `data`, with `meta` (total capped at 10,000 unless exact_total, current_page, last_page, per_page, after) and `facets` when asked. `direct_url` and `urls.direct` are the merchant page. `commission_url`, `urls.affiliate` and `urls.outclick` carry `@@@`/`###` placeholders when the account has a network link template, and are null when it does not. Product objects vary by merchant; undeclared fields are kept.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `data` as the primary payload key.
